regime_context: The detector shows Banks as the clear momentum leader (rank 1, durability 0.67, breadth 0.72) with crowded texture (z=1.6), but the absolute-trend gate has NOT helped on this market's history (gate_helps=false, mean-reverting tape) and the backtest confirms rank-IC is weak/insignificant. Rotation is narrowing (6 of 22 eligible) and non-directional. This is a display/experimental regime — no validated edge to extract from ranks, so leans must be humble and conditional.
emerging_watch: Watch whether AI Compute's narrow breadth (0.176) broadens above 0.35 while Banks' breadth (0.722) falls below 0.5 — one confirmed handoff condition would be AI Compute closing the score gap to under 0.05 margin for 5 consecutive sessions while Banks loses the rank-1 slot; at that point the leadership watch shifts from Banks to a genuine challenger, otherwise the watch retires.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics is the only top-tier theme with a clean trend leg: hurst_tag=trend, eligible, not crowded (z=-0.56), and rank 2 with score 0.905 close to the leader. The trend eligibility (absolute-trend gate) is the one leg with a marginal drawdown-control read even here, and the uncrowded texture avoids the reflexivity caution that applies to Banks. However, cross-sectional rank is a focus lens only, so this is a conditional lean on continuation of the trend leg, not a momentum claim.
theses.dissent: Breadth is only 0.176 — the theme's leadership is narrow within the AI complex, and with the dominant macro narrative being AI/tech (coincident flow), attention spikes in thematic ETFs can mark tops per guardrails. A mean-reverting tape could whipsaw this trend leg as it has for the gate.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks has the strongest durability (0.67) and breadth (0.722) of any theme, which supports narrative cohesion/durability even though the momentum rank itself is not alpha. The crowding flag (z=1.6) is a size-down caution only, never a fade. With gate_helps=false, I express this as a low-conviction continuation lean grounded in breadth durability rather than trend-gate edge. The r10 of -0.022 suggests momentum has already cooled slightly, which reduces but does not eliminate the reflexivity risk.
theses.dissent: Crowded at z=1.6 into a mean-reverting tape is the classic setup for a shake-out, and the absolute-trend gate historically failed to cut drawdown here — meaning the leader can fall hard without the discipline saving you. Negative r10 (-0.022) hints the edge is already fading.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS underperforms CSI 300 by 3% over a rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Solar / Photovoltaics
theses.thesis: Solar sits at rank 22 with the most negative score (-1.24), ineligible, and the most negative crowding z (-2.2). In a mean-reverting tape this is not a fade or short — it is simply a theme with no trend support and no durability leg worth anchoring to. Avoid is the right conditional: no positive structural leg justifies exposure, and the failed gate means no drawdown edge from dip-buying the laggard.
theses.dissent: A mean-reverting tape with extreme negative crowding could overshoot to the upside on any positive policy or tariff news — but the guardrails forbid treating crowding extremes as a contrarian buy, and there is no confirmed handoff to Solar.

falsifier.text: 515790.SS moves into eligible territory (trend gate turns true) and ranks in the top half before the check-by date
